name: pons-operations
description: Guides end-user and creator workflows on pons (Robinhood Chain launchpad): browse launches, verify token address, buy/sell, create a launch, track graduation, claim creator fees, community takeovers (CTO), and risk checks. Covers v1 (live WETH/Uniswap V3 pools) and v2 (bonding curve → Uniswap V4). Use when the user asks to "trade on pons", "launch a token on pons", "claim pons creator fees", "pons CTO", "graduate on pons", "buy pons launch", "pons launchpad", or "how do I use pons". DO NOT use for indexer/ABI integration (skill:pons-integration) or deep contract architecture (skill:pons-architecture).
